tab-router--generate-routing-rules.label: Generate routing rules from open tabs

controls.label: Bookmark / Saved
controls.description: The same ribbon path fills on save and retains its outline. Notch shifts0.5 units; satellite remains separate from the border.
controls.windContract: Current minus0.03 of next-state delta, capped0.2 units per coordinate. Stable/collapsed components remain unchanged; fill stays in current state.
controls.contourRestoration: Symmetric radius-2 cubic top corners replace the asymmetric page-like bevel. Bounds, 1.5-unit stroke, lower tip/notch contours, 0.5-unit saved notch shift, fill states, axis hint and diamond retained. Source-grounded contour correction; not a new user approval.

controls.label: Pause / Resume download
controls.description: Same two polygons morph between resume triangle and pause bars. Confirmed native download state determines the held endpoint.
controls.windContract: Current minus0.03 of next-state delta, capped0.2 units per coordinate. Stable/collapsed components remain unchanged; fill stays in current state.

controls.label: Menu / Close
controls.description: Three persistent strokes follow the original study landmarks: outer bars become diagonals; middle bar contracts to zero length. No opacity swap.

controls.label: Compact / Expanded
controls.description: Exactly one2.5-unit closed frame and one divider. The frame contracts from the left while its right, top and bottom anchors remain fixed.
controls.contourRestoration: Original Circuit rrect corner construction; outer radius 3, inner radius 0.5, cubic control distance 0.38r. Existing frame bounds, divider geometry and state behavior retained; no new approval implied.

controls.label: Show / Hide sidebar
controls.description: Exactly one fixed2.5-unit frame and one divider. Divider travels from the inner left boundary into the window; closed state has zero divider area.
controls.contourRestoration: Original Circuit rrect corner construction; outer radius 3, inner radius 0.5, cubic control distance 0.38r. Existing frame bounds, divider geometry and state behavior retained; no new approval implied.

controls.label: Fullscreen / Restore
controls.description: Four persistent corner paths fold between outward and inward bends. Endpoints remain fixed; no full frame or extra outline appears.
